title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 24: divorce, a new husband's year at home, pledges, fair wages and the forgotten sheaf.

questions.text: What did a man have to give his wife when he sent her away?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

questions.text: What could the first husband not do after his former wife had become another man's wife?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says her former husband may not take her again to be his wife; that would be an abomination to Yahweh.

answers.text: Take her again as his wife

questions.text: How long was a newly married man to be free at home?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says he shall not go out in the army; he shall be free at home one year and cheer his wife.

questions.text: Why was no one to take a mill or upper millstone as a pledge?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that whoever does so "takes a life in pledge."

answers.text: Because millstones belonged to the priests
Because it was too heavy to carry
Because he would be taking a life in pledge
Because it could only be sold in Egypt

questions.text: What was the punishment for a man who stole a fellow Israelite and sold him?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says that thief shall die, so the evil is removed from among them.

answers.text: He was to pay back double
He was to be sent out of the camp
He was to become a slave himself

questions.text: Whom does verse 9 tell Israel to remember, in connection with the plague of leprosy?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt."

questions.text: When lending to a neighbor, how was the pledge to be collected?
questions.explanation: The lender was not to go into the house; he was to stand outside, and the borrower would bring the pledge out to him.

answers.text: The lender went in and chose it himself
A priest went into the house to get it
The elders took it from his house for him
The lender waited outside; the borrower brought it out

questions.text: When was a poor man's pledge to be given back?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says to restore it when the sun goes down, so he may sleep in his garment and bless the lender.

answers.text: At the end of the week
When the debt was fully paid

questions.text: According to verse 16, for whose sin was every man to be put to death?
questions.explanation: Fathers were not to die for children, nor children for fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

questions.text: For whom was a forgotten sheaf in the field to be left?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says it shall be for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.

answers.text: The priests and the Levites of the city
The foreigner, the fatherless and the widow
The servants of the king's house
